name: CloudGPU MCP
description: Lets an AI agent rent a GPU on cloudgpu.app by the minute: list GPUs with live prices and templates (JupyterLab, Ollama, ComfyUI, LLaMA-Factory), get a quote, create an instance from an approved quote with server-enforced spend, time and idle limits, run commands, tail logs, upload and download files over SFTP, and destroy the instance. Also lists models on the same account's OpenAI-compatible API. CLOUDGPU_READ_ONLY=1 registers only the look-up tools.
author: CloudGPU

CLOUDGPU_API_KEY.description: API key from https://cloudgpu.app/api; usage is paid from the account's prepaid balance.

CLOUDGPU_MAX_SPEND_USD.description: Highest budget in USD the agent may set for one instance (default 50).

CLOUDGPU_MAX_HOURS.description: Longest time limit in hours the agent may set for one instance (default 24).

CLOUDGPU_READ_ONLY.description: Set to 1 to register only the look-up tools.
